pull.title: sql: treat descriptor validation errors as permanent schema change errors
pull.body:
Descriptor validation errors cannot be fixed by retrying, so the schema changer should stop retrying and fail the job instead of spinning until the backoff cap.

This makes `isPermanentSchemaChangeError` return true for validation errors.

Informs #101100

Release note: None

commit.message:

reviews.body: Makes sense to me: retrying a validation failure just delays the inevitable.
